title: Directional subregion phrases and continent fallback protection
body:
DIRECTIONAL SUBREGION UNDERSTANDING
- Added recognition for natural directional subregion phrasing (such as "southern part of Africa", "south of Africa", "południowa część Afryki") across African, European, and Asian regions.
- Added protection against false continent-level fallbacks when a question asks about a directional portion of a continent (e.g. "southern part of Africa" will never reduce to "in Africa" for Northern African countries like Tunisia).
- Supported common colloquial spelling variants (such as "on te southern part of africa").
